_doc: Manifest-driven unified engagement gate for vLLM APC fixes on Qwen3-Next GDN-hybrid. For EACH active APC fix flag the gate asserts (a) flag=1 in the WORKER via the bridge marker AND (b) the engagement counter incremented >0. counter_key=null means the counter is MISSING and the gate FAILS LOUD (a flag with no engagement counter can never be silently trusted). See FR13_APC_UNIFIED_ENGAGEMENT_GATE.md.
